# MD Fit

> Physical rehabilitation and pain treatment in Sarasota, FL, led by Dr. Jared Caban (MD, MSc, CCEP, LMT), plus an app with programs and remote sessions for people anywhere in the US. Educational content, not a diagnosis.

## Start here
- [Muscle library](https://www.mymdfit.com/muscles/): where each of 67 muscles refers pain, self-checks and a 3-phase relief plan
- [Pain locations](https://www.mymdfit.com/pain/): which muscles cause pain in each spot
- [Conditions](https://www.mymdfit.com/conditions/)
- [Exercise library](https://www.mymdfit.com/exercises/)
- [Programs](https://www.mymdfit.com/programs/)
- [Membership and remote care](https://www.mymdfit.com/membership)
- [Dr. Jared Caban](https://www.mymdfit.com/dr-jared-caban)
- [Book an evaluation](https://www.mymdfit.com/book)

## Practice facts
- MD Fit, 3214 Clark Road, Sarasota, FL 34231. 941-313-0562. Mon–Fri 8 AM–4 PM.
- Self-pay practice: no insurance billing, no referral needed.
- [Pain finder](https://www.mymdfit.com/pain-finder): tap where it hurts to see which muscles commonly cause it
